integrity: The positive direction identifies the unit group of an explicit twisted dual-number ring, and the negative direction derives characteristic two, vanishing Jacobson radical, semisimplicity, and a simple-group obstruction. A standalone checker verifies the explicit ring-unit isomorphism for four even finite fields.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for finite realizing rings only.
Only degree-one affine groups are treated.
The twisted dual-number semidirect-product construction is prior ring theory; the new statement is the exact all-finite-field realizability classification.
title: Degree-one affine groups over finite fields have an exact realizability dichotomy
